name: What is the advantage of using a general remodeling contractor over a drywall-only company for bathroom repairs?

mainEntity.name: What is the advantage of using a general remodeling contractor over a drywall-only company for bathroom repairs?

acceptedAnswer.text: Hiring a full-service remodeling contractor gives you a cohesive finish across drywall, tile, trim, and paint without juggling separate sub-trades. Drywall specialists often leave repairs ready for paint, meaning the homeowner must source another painter or complete finish coats themselves. A general remodeling contractor who provides carpentry, drywall, tile, and interior painting can patch the wall, reinstall vanity mirrors or base moldings, and paint the entire room for a uniform appearance. This approach minimizes schedule gaps and ensures all finishes around plumbing fixtures and trim align cleanly.
acceptedAnswer.description: A general remodeler handles framing, drywall, trim, tile, and finish painting together, delivering a complete, paint-ready room without hiring multiple separate trades.
